data.collector.yaml:
exporters:
  file:
    flush_interval: 1s
    path: /evidence/telemetry.jsonl
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      http:
        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4318
service:
  pipelines:
    metrics:
      exporters:
      - file
      receivers:
      - otlp
    traces:
      exporters:
      - file
      receivers:
      - otlp
data.obi.yaml:
attributes:
  kubernetes:
    enable: true
discovery:
  exclude_otel_instrumented_services: false
metrics:
  features:
  - application
otel_metrics_export:
  endpoint: http://collector:4318
  protocol: http/protobuf
otel_traces_export:
  batch_timeout: 1s
  endpoint: http://collector:4318
  protocol: http/protobuf
routes:
  patterns:
  - /checkout
  - /inventory
  unmatched: path
